*CEO Eduardo Menezes and CFO Melissa Schaeffer to Participate in a Fireside Chat*


LEHIGH VALLEY, Pa.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Air Products' (NYSE:APD ) Chief Executive Officer[Eduardo Menezes](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830195-1&h=1821669813&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.airproducts.com%2Fcompany%2Fleadership%2Feduardo-menezes-bio&a=Eduardo+Menezes) and Chief Financial Officer[Melissa Schaeffer](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830195-1&h=4199142033&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.airproducts.com%2Fcompany%2Fleadership%2Fmelissa-schaeffer-bio&a=Melissa+Schaeffer) will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference on Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. USET.


Access the audio webcast from Air Products' Investor Relations[Event Details](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830195-1&h=1519292050&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fevents%2Fevent-details%2Fair-products-goldman-sachs-industrials-and-materials-conference-1&a=Event+Details) website.


**About Air Products**


Air Products (NYSE:[APD](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830195-1&h=2444272874&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fstock-information&a=APD) ) is a world-leading industrial gases company in operation for more than 85 years. Serving energy, environmental, and emerging markets, the Company is generating a cleaner future by providing essential industrial gases, related equipment, and applications expertise that help customers improve productivity, efficiency, and sustainability across a wide range of industries, including energy, chemicals, electronics, metals, manufacturing, food, medical, and space.


Air Products is focused on profitably growing its core industrial gases business, accelerating growth in areas of competitive strength, and extending its reach through disciplined opportunities that create long-term value. As the leading global supplier of hydrogen, Air Products develops, engineers, builds, owns and operates some of the world's largest hydrogen projects and has extensive capabilities in air separation technology, engineering, and plant operations. Through its sale of equipment businesses, the Company also provides specialized products such as turbomachinery, membrane systems, and cryogenic containers globally.


Air Products had fiscal 2026 sales of $13.0 billion from operations in approximately 50 countries.
